rawAnswer: {"story":{"what":"TypeCollector now sends every analyzer diagnostic through a filter that drops any diagnostic whose location is not a source location in the compilation being analyzed. Two places that read a member's declaring syntax by index (DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0]) now tolerate members that have no syntax, as members of types loaded from metadata do. The change also turns the compound assignment for [Ignore]-attributed fields from |= into &=. New generator tests compile a defining assembly to a metadata-only image. They check that the analyzers and generator report nothing for closed generic structs and record structs from it, and that the resolver source is generated.
